At this forecasted level of net sales, the Company is now forecasting adjusted operating income for fiscal year 2026 to be in the range of $560 million to $590 million, an increase compared to previously communicated guidance range of $550 million to $580 million, and compared to fiscal year 2025 adjusted operating income of $403 million.

(the “Company”) increased the size of the Board from nine to ten directors, effective as of September 14, 2026, and appointed Gerri Martin-Flickinger to fill the resulting vacancy, to hold office until her successor is duly elected and qualified or until her earlier death, resignation or removal.

material_events.basis: stated in the cited item (10-K MD&A footnote)

risks.basis: Stated in P4 and P6; the non-recurrence is inferred from the refund being described as covering over 95% of IEEPA tariffs paid.
risks.claim: Q2 2026 reported operating income of $257 million included a $135 million one-time IEEPA tariff refund benefit; adjusted operating income was $124 million.
quotes: The increase in operating income compared to the second quarter of 2025 was primarily driven by an increase in net sales, a $135 million benefit from the recognition of IEEPA tariff refund recoveries in costs of goods sold and improved merchandise margins.

risks.claim: New Section 301 tariffs of 10% to 12.5% took effect after the IEEPA tariffs were struck down, and the company says their future impact is unclear.
quotes: In July 2026, the U.S. administration imposed new tariffs ranging from 10% to 12.5% under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974, effective July 24, 2026.

We estimate tariffs, net of mitigation efforts, negatively impacted our operating income during fiscal 2025 by approximately $85 million and resulted in increased expenses, supply chain disruption, and uncertainty.

risks.basis: Figures stated in F1 and F3; the seasonal concentration is stated in P1 and P2; the markdown risk is inferred from P2.
risks.claim: Inventories rose to 1,146 from 1,058 a year earlier (table in millions), ahead of a fourth quarter that typically provides about one-third of net sales.
quotes: The fourth quarter, including the holiday season, typically accounts for approximately one-third of our net sales and is normally our most profitable quarter.
We typically accumulate a significant amount of inventory in the months preceding the holiday season selling period.

We are increasing our strategic marketing investment to expand our reach, deepen customer connection, and build on the brand heat we are creating.

unknowns: The packet holds no third- or fourth-quarter 2026 actual results, so it cannot show whether the raised full-year guidance was met.
Whether further IEEPA tariff refunds will be received is unknown; the company recorded no receivable for them.
The effect on margins of the Section 301 tariffs effective July 24, 2026 is not quantified in the evidence.
No capital expenditure guidance for fiscal 2026 or later is given.
The full-year operating income guidance is stated as a dollar range, not as an operating margin, so it cannot be used directly as margin guidance.
